import sys,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
from canonref import hdr
# raw helper for overlong v width
def vw(val,width): return (([1,2,4,8].index(width)<<(8*width-2))|val).to_bytes(width,'big')

def test(name,level,rawpayload,canonpayload,seed=None,auth=0):
    # raw envelope width1 pn0; canonical pn width likely1
    w=envelope(level,0,rawpayload,width=1,phase=0)
    rec={'I':None,'H':None,'A':None}
    if seed is not None:rec[level]=seed
    ev=[{'keys':['I','H','A']},datagram(w,(auth,))]
    r=run(trace(ev,received=rec))['traces'][0]
    p=r['packets'][0]
    exp=hdr(level,p['pn'],0 if seed is None else seed+1,canonpayload,phase=0)
    ok=p['status']=='OK' and p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest()
    print(name,p['status'],'hashok',ok,'canonhex',exp.hex() if not ok else '')
    if not ok: print(' expected payload',canonpayload.hex(),'actualhash',p['sha256'])

# padding + ping canonical same
test('padping','I',b'\x00\x00\x01\x01',b'\x00\x00\x01\x01')
# stream with overlong id0, offset0, length3(type0f), canonical 0f 00 00 03 abc
raw=b'\x0f'+vw(0,2)+vw(0,4)+vw(3,8)+b'abc'
can=b'\x0f'+v(0)+v(0)+v(3)+b'abc'
test('overlongstream','I',raw,can)
# stream type 08 no off/no len data consumes rest, canonical same type
test('streamlengthless','A',b'\x08'+v(1)+b'xyz',b'\x08'+v(1)+b'xyz')
# ACK type2 overlong all vals: 9,0,1,2,1,3 canonical
raw=b'\x02'+vw(9,2)+vw(0,4)+vw(1,8)+vw(2,2)+vw(1,4)+vw(3,8)
can=b'\x02'+v(9)+v(0)+v(1)+v(2)+v(1)+v(3)
test('overlongack','I',raw,can)
# ACK_ECN
raw=b'\x03'+vw(5,2)+vw(1,2)+vw(0,2)+vw(5,2)+vw(1,2)+vw(1,1)+vw(2,2)+vw(3,4)
can=b'\x03'+v(5)+v(1)+v(0)+v(5)+v(1)+v(1)+v(2)+v(3)
test('ackecn','I',raw,can)
# crypto overlong offset len
raw=b'\x06'+vw(2,2)+vw(3,4)+b'abc'+b'\x01'
can=b'\x06'+v(2)+v(3)+b'abc'+b'\x01'
test('cryptoover','I',raw,can)
# NCI seq overlong etc
cid=b'xy';tok=b'z'*16
raw=b'\x18'+vw(1,2)+vw(0,4)+bytes([2])+cid+tok
can=b'\x18'+v(1)+v(0)+bytes([2])+cid+tok
test('nciover','A',raw,can)
# close stops trailing: transport close body + malformed bytes
raw=b'\x1c'+vw(0,2)+vw(0,2)+vw(2,2)+b'ok'+b'\x40'
can=b'\x1c'+v(0)+v(0)+v(2)+b'ok'
test('closeprefix','I',raw,can)
# datagram 30 consumes rest: body arbitrary incl
test('dg30','A',b'\x30hello',b'\x30hello')
# datagram31 len2 data + ping
raw=b'\x31'+vw(2,4)+b'hi'+b'\x01'
can=b'\x31'+v(2)+b'hi'+b'\x01'
test('dg31','A',raw,can)
# path exactly8 then ping
p=b'12345678'
test('path','A',b'\x1a'+p+b'\x01',b'\x1a'+p+b'\x01')
